description: This Java class, ConditionValidator, is a validator for Condition objects. It ensures that the object provided is not null, is an instance of Condition, and that specific fields (condition and clinicalStatus) are not null, in accordance with validation rules. The class uses Spring Framework's Validator interface and is annotated with a custom Handler annotation to support Condition objects.

classes.name: ConditionValidator
classes.description: A validator class for validating Condition objects, ensuring required fields are present and correct type.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the validator supports the class of the object to be validated; returns true if it supports Condition class or its subclasses.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a given object, checks for null, correct type, and non-null required fields; throws IllegalArgumentException if invalid conditions are met.
